  Scissors, Paper, Paper         3 for the Scissors player, 0 for each Paper player
  Paper, Paper, Rock             1.5 for each Paper player, 0 for the Rock player
  Paper, Rock, Rock              3 for the Paper player, 0 for each Rock player
